judgement.why: Ten Gretchin with the Extra Sneaky upgrade (Runt Swarm, UPGRADE, “GRETCHIN unit only”; the export gives it to two Gretchin units, this one and Zodgrod’s): 45 + 10 pts. Legal: Core Rules 25.04 (Wahapedia) lets an army include “up to three of the same Upgrade … (the second and third instances of the same Upgrade do not count towards the total number of enhancements in your army, but you must still spend the stated points cost each time)”, and an attached unit can be given an Upgrade (FAQ). The other ten Gretchin (gretchin-2) have none.
